{{Quote|I heard a rumor that there's some secret enemy research facility deep within the Itani Nebula conducting some pretty important experiments. Something about studying condensing gases, energy discharges, and plasma clouds to try and make a weapon that consumes a planet's atmosphere with acid. Or was it incinerate a planet into a small, boiling sun? Something like that. Anyway, the station's supposedly bristling with sensors, instruments, and equipment to divert harmful ion lightning.|[[Snitchly Gritch]]|<ref name="QS" />}}
The '''Imperial research station''', also known as '''Itani Base''',<ref name="TFUCG" /> was a secret but much-rumored [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]/[[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] hidden in a pocket of open [[Realspace/Legends|space]] within the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]. It was full of labs where scientists and weapons technicians studied local gases, magnetic storms, and [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]] to come up with new gas explosives and more powerful [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weapons]]. The station was protected by a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]] and a hidden [[Mine/Legends|minefield]]. It was eventually destroyed by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strike team.
